dimensions.label: Scope
dimensions.reason: Trivial fixture — exercises the orchestrator, not real code.

problem: A synthetic project used only to validate the autopilot Workflow engine's wave ordering, parallel dispatch, failure gating, skip propagation, and resume.
goals: Prove the engine behaves correctly on a diamond graph with one rigged failure.

phases.title: Phase 2 — independent branch
phases.notes: Writes sentinel phase2.done. Sibling of Phase 3; must still complete when Phase 3 fails.

phases.title: Phase 3 — rigged failure
phases.notes: Validation deliberately exits 1 — forces the failure gate.

phases.title: Phase 4 — dependent on the failure
phases.notes: Depends on Phase 3 — must be SKIPPED when Phase 3 fails.
